title: Traffic
subtitle: Visitor traffic served by your reverse proxy, from its local access log.
statP95Hint: 95% of requests were served faster than this.
statBotsHint: Share of requests classified as bots, out of requests the proxy could classify.
chartRequestsDesc: Requests counted per time bucket (not a per-second rate).
chartStatusDesc: Responses per bucket by status class.
chartBandwidthDesc: Response data sent per time bucket.
chartP95Desc: 95th-percentile response time per time bucket, estimated from a latency histogram. Buckets with no latency data are left blank.
noPaths: No paths recorded in this range.
countriesDesc: Share of requests with a known country. Requests whose country could not be determined are not included.
countriesCoverage: {located} of {total} requests have a known country.
noCountries: No country data in this range.
breakdownDesc: Top values per dimension. Share is out of all of this dimension's requests; values not listed are grouped under Everything else.
emptyBody: Traffic Analytics may be turned off, or no requests have reached your proxy in this range. To enable it, open Servers, pick a server, go to Maintenance and turn on Traffic analytics.
toggleDesc: Record visitor requests (path, status, size, country) in the proxy's local access log to power the Traffic page. Data stays on your own server and hub; nothing is sent to any third party.
toggleReadOnly: You have read-only access to this server.
toggleDeferred: Traffic analytics saved; applies on next proxy start
toggleFailed: Traffic analytics saved, but re-applying the proxy failed
toggleFailedDetail: Traffic analytics saved, but re-applying the proxy failed: {error}
toggleNotInPool: Traffic analytics saved; this server is not in the proxy pool yet
toggleClusterShared: Traffic analytics saved; the cluster's shared ingress applies it
